mn118:5.2: “It seems the Buddha will wait right there in Sāvatthī for the Komudī full moon of the fourth month.”
mn118:13.2: There are such mendicants in this Saṅgha.
mn118:38.4: As they live mindfully in this way they investigate, explore, and inquire into that principle with wisdom.
mn118:38.6: As they investigate principles with wisdom in this way their energy is roused up and unflagging.
mn118:38.8: When they’re energetic, rapture not of the flesh arises.
mn118:38.10: When the mind is full of rapture, the body and mind become tranquil.
mn118:38.12: When the body is tranquil and they feel bliss, the mind becomes immersed in samādhi.
mn118:39.1: They closely watch over that mind immersed in samādhi.
mn118:43.4: Mindfulness of Breathing is finished—the eighth.
